From a 30-day visit to a family stay permit. Standard visas can be paid online; for longer stays we check your documents with you first.

title: sec center
html:
About us

Our story

Visa4Bali started in Balangan in 2014. Our owner, Mr. Rolly, has handled visa applications and stay-permit problems ever since, and he still works on difficult cases himself.

Our promise

You should be able to enjoy Bali while we deal with immigration. We prepare every document, keep you updated on WhatsApp, and work with immigration directly, not through brokers.
